and Yahweh sent you on a journey, and said, ‘Go, and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them…

translations.web: “ ‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.
translations.bsb: No person set apart for destruction may be ransomed; he must surely be put to death.
translations.kjv: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.
translations.asv: No one devoted, that shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.
